headline: Bose’s next open earbuds have more bass, more volume, and more battery life
summary: Bose announced new Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen). They feature improved sound quality, more bass, and extended battery life. A cheaper alternative is also being introduced.

headline: Spotify’s Fresh Finds Forward gives artists free studio time and more
summary: Spotify launches Fresh Finds Forward to help emerging artists. The program offers tools like free studio time to capitalize on playlist exposure. Artists added to Fresh Finds after Jan 1, 2026, are eligible.

headline: Grand Theft Auto VI’s soundtrack will feature 34 brand-new tracks
summary: Rockstar announced the Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album soundtrack. It will include 34 brand-new, original tracks. The first six singles are available now.

headline: The Apple Watch Series 12 is the start of a new wearable era
summary: The Apple Watch Series 12 marks a significant shift in wearable technology. Despite a familiar design, it includes major internal changes. These changes lay groundwork for future innovations.

headline: GTA 6 Soundtrack Gets Physical CD and Vinyl Release, Rockstar Confirms
summary: Rockstar confirms a physical release for the Grand Theft Auto 6 soundtrack. It will be available on both CD and vinyl. This news came via a new leak.

headline: Tiny Fugitives Review
summary: "Tiny Fugitives" stars Johnny Knoxville and follows kids wanting to live at camp. The film has sweet moments but lacks clear direction. It struggles to define its genre or message.

headline: Twitch Boss Says Game Companies Are Right to Avoid Competing With GTA 6 for Attention — Expects GTA Online 2 Next Year
summary: Twitch boss Dan Clancy expects a massive GTA 6 launch this November. He advises other game companies to avoid competing with its release. Clancy anticipates GTA Online 2 (or similar) will launch next year.

headline: Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back Announced, With Juliet Starling Now on Skates
summary: Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back has been officially announced. Zombie-killing cheerleader Juliet Starling returns as the protagonist. She will now be featured on skates in the sequel.

headline: Palace in war of words with Earl Spencer over claims in Diana book
summary: A dispute has erupted between the Palace and Earl Spencer. The conflict stems from claims made in a new Diana book. The row risks overshadowing a busy day for the Royal family.

headline: Father's tribute to 'sweetest little boy' Noah Woods
summary: Rhys Woods paid a heartfelt tribute to his three-year-old son, Noah. He expressed profound gratitude for community support. The family is mourning the loss of their "sweetest little boy."

headline: Family of 'Putney pusher' suspect say he was innocent and blame police for his death
summary: The family of Nicholas Brandram, 'Putney pusher' suspect, claims his innocence. They state no forensic evidence linked him to the incident. Police are blamed for his death.

headline: Uncontrolled AI could lead to 'silicon species' rivalling humans, Microsoft boss tells BBC
summary: Microsoft boss Mustafa Suleyman warns of uncontrolled AI. He suggests it could lead to "silicon species" rivalling humans. Suleyman believes Anthropic is teaching Claude it "may be conscious."
